results.fact: Aspect/face of the documented Walrus Glacier line
results.evidence: Still real: aspect W / face "West Ridge" while the row describes the Walrus Glacier (east side) and a scramble via the south ridge of Pt. 8373 and the final south/west ridge. results.fact: Is the balanced summit block usually climbed? descent_text says most parties do not attempt it; beta/pro_tips/pro_needs say most parties protect/belay it
results.evidence: Still real: descent_text says most parties do not attempt the summit boulder; beta says most protect it and pro_needs says most belay it. Sources found describe individual parties (one skipped it; others threw a rope over the top and belayed or jugged it) and grade it V1, but none states what most parties do. No patch.

results.fact: Commitment grade - Grade IV (in `grade`) vs commitment III

results.fact: Side of the summit the slung-horn rappel leaves from: descent/rappels say south/southwest, other CBR routes say east
results.correct_value: The 30 m summit rappel goes down the east side from a slung horn
results.evidence: Two independent accounts put the standard summit rappel on the EAST side: a descent guide gives a short rappel to the east from in-situ slings, and a trip-report series (West Face, The Scoop, Let it Burn) describes a 30 m rappel to the east from a slung horn before scrambling scree clockwise around the peak; a third report describes a single 25 m rappel down the east side. The one dissenting listing places the slung chickenhead on the south/southwest face without stating the rappel direction. descent and rappels on this row are changed to east; descent_text does not name a side.

results.fact: dist_km 17.06 (10.6 mi) is shown as the one-way approach but equals the itinerary round trip; the col waypoint is at 5.3 mi
results.evidence: Still real: dist_km 17.06 km equals the itinerary's 10.6 mi round trip while the col waypoint is at 5.3 mi one way. Sources give 4 mi to the lake plus about an hour to the col; none states a one-way trailhead-to-col mileage, and a value derived by adding or halving is not allowed. No patch.

results.fact: Summit-day length and start time: partner_requirements vs timing/itinerary
results.evidence: Still real: partner_requirements says a 04:00 start and an 8.5-hr round trip; timing/itinerary say a 2:30 AM start and an 11-hr summit day. Further reports found give couloir climbing times of 2.5-3.5 hr and camp departures of 4:30-5 AM, but they mostly concern the neighbouring North Buttress Couloir and none gives a camp-to-camp time for this line. No patch.
